category: Transformer encoder block (attention + FFN + residuals, composition)
edge_cases: the full encoder block: self-attention sub-layer (X.X^T-HMX -> scale+softmax-HVX -> A.V-HMX) + residual1 + FFN sub-layer (up-HMX -> ReLU/requant-HVX -> down-HMX) + residual2, requant between every stage
FOUR matmuls on the HMX engine (X.X^T 64x64x64, A.V 64x64x64, up 64x128x64, down 64x64x128); FFN intermediate H staged VTCM-resident between the two FFN matmuls (bulk 128B vector copy in/out)

documented simplifications: self-attention uses X directly as Q,K,V (no separate QKV/output projections); LayerNorm omitted for a residual+requant path (norms would blow the sim budget and add no new mechanism group)

chaining four matmuls through the 12-bit HMX requant field requires aggressive requant shifts so intermediates stay small: X.X^T |acc|<=576, A.V<=765, up-proj<=1152, down-proj<=1792 -> all *17/16 < 2048 (every field exact, block bit-exact)
residual add 1: h = clamp_u8(X + attn_out) (uint8 FFN activation); residual add 2: out = sat_i8(h + ffn_out) (int8)
FFN ReLU sparsity: b1[0]=-4000 (column always killed), b1[1]=+4000 (always fires); output saturation: b2[0]=-4000 (sat-low -128), b2[1]=+4000 (sat-high +127)
crouton pack/unpack + H staging moved to/from VTCM in bulk 128B HVX vector copies (scalar VTCM access ~48 cyc would lose)

harness reference computed via four HVX vrmpy matmuls, cross-checked against an INDEPENDENT full scalar golden on row 0 (Q6_Q_vsetq_R only encodes 0..127, so the 128-length down-proj must NOT be predicate-masked)
nearmiss_skip_attn_residual drops residual1 (h = attn_out, no + X) -> INCORRECT (3008/4096 wrong)
nearmiss_skip_ffn_residual drops residual2 (out = ffn_out, no + h) -> INCORRECT (3008/4096 wrong)
name: i8_transformer_encoder_block

params.exp_lut: 256 uint8 entries (runtime), fixed-point exp, index 255 = exp(0)
